    Roiter's vanishing theorem #

    A contour function with values in an abelian group Z assigns c p q ∈ Z to paths p, q with the same nonzero value, additively in the contour and invariantly under common whiskers; it is exact if c p q = a(p) − a(q) for a function a on the arrows. Roiter's theorem (Fischbacher, §3.2): on a finite chain-bounded ray category with cancellation every contour function is exact (RayCat.ContourFn.exact). The proof follows the reduction of Lemma 2.1/2.2.
